name: The Stone Giant
notes: DRAFT for C13-5 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Green Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (the scaling guide puts a Guardian at about 90% of the tier max; hits-to-beat in the 40-80 boss band). Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: stone toss
attacks.note: Tosses stones that land in red circles.

phases.tell: It lifts one huge foot; big red circle.
phases.counterplay: COUNTER, or step out of the big circle.
phases.senseiLine: Big feet are slow feet. Wait.

phases.tell: It picks up stones; circles show where they land.
phases.counterplay: Step out, then come back close.
phases.senseiLine: Watch where they land. Then move.

phases.tell: Two striped lanes, one after the other, each with double marks.
phases.senseiLine: Two slides. One DASH, then another.

lines.intro: So tall and so loud. But are those only stones?
lines.freed: I was only stones and worry. Thank you for not running away.
lines.senseiAfter: Big things can still fall to a brave, small heart.

description: The Stone Giant stomps, tosses stones, then sends two rock slides down striped lanes, one after the other.

bestiary.tip: It looks big. Stay brave and steady.

lore.green: Very tall and very loud. Inside, it is only a pile of stones the shadow stacked up. Free it, and its light comes home.
